keyEvents.text: Goal! Borussia Dortmund 1, Paderborn 0. Fábio Silva (Borussia Dortmund) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Serhou Guirassy following a fast break.
Laurin Ulrich (Paderborn) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Borussia Dortmund 1, Paderborn 0.
